system.description:
Binding a ghost with its name and the sheer weight of your will, you break its defiance and press it into obedient service.

First use Summon Soul to manifest the wraith, then engage it in a Social Challenge on the turn it appears, retesting with Occult. The wraith may spend Pathos to resist, forcing you to expend one Social Trait per Pathos spent. If you win, it is bound to obey your commands and answer truthfully for a full hour, remaining visible and audible to you. Spending a temporary Willpower Trait binds it for the entire evening; a permanent Willpower Trait binds it for a year and a day.
system.source: Laws of the Night Revised, Disciplines
